meta_description:
127K likes, 1,573 comments - beebomco on October 10, 2026: "The Illegal Calculator!

This is a scientific calculator that looks and works like a regular one. It handles addition, subtraction, multiplication and trigonometric functions like Sin, Cos and Tan, along with the other functions you would expect.

But, entering 1 2 3 4 5 6 unlocks a hidden chat mode. In this mode, you can type messages using the number keys, similar to old keypad phones.

The calculator connects to a phone over Bluetooth. You can send messages from the calculator to the phone, and the phone can send messages back to the calculator.

It can also search the internet. You type what you want to search for, press the Tan button, and the result appears on the calculator’s screen.

The calculator has built-in memory that can store large amounts of text. You can scroll through the saved text on the screen and delete it instantly.

When you are done, pressing a button switches the calculator back to its regular calculator mode.".
